title: Claudia Tenney marks Veterans Day with VFW event and comments on congressional disputes
text:
Rep. Claudia Tenney, who represents New York’s 24th district in the U.S. Congress, posted a series of messages on her social media accounts on November 11 and 12, 2025, addressing Veterans Day commemorations and commenting on recent political developments.
On November 11, Tenney wrote about her participation in a local Veterans Day event: “This Veterans Day I was honored to spend time with the brave men and women of VFW Post 369 in Mexico. The ceremony brought together veterans, Auxiliary members, and local leaders to recognize the courage and sacrifice that safeguard our freedoms. I am grateful for their https://t.co/UWcHp9r5Ql” (posted November 11, 2025). She also shared a separate link in another post: “https://t.co/VLd39Tyka8” (posted November 11, 2025).
The following day, Tenney commented on congressional debates regarding government shutdowns and healthcare policy: “The same Democrats who screamed for weeks about the shutdown are now angry it’s reopening. These are the same people screaming about affordability while their Unaffordable Care Act crushed the small businesses that drive our economy. https://t.co/z4QNJbyUB4” (posted November 12, 2025).
Claudia Tenney has served as a member of Congress since replacing Anthony Brindisi in 2021. Before her current role representing New York’s 24th District, she was a member of the New York State Assembly from 2011 to 2016. Born in New Hartford in 1961 and currently residing in Canandaigua, Tenney holds degrees from Colgate University and the University of Cincinnati.
